newsitem.title: UK: Siebe leads advance in engineering stocks.
newsitem.headline: Siebe leads advance in engineering stocks.

text.p: Engineering stocks were squeezed higher on Monday, led by a sharp advance in Siebe, after IMI Plc posted well received annual results and the sector was further helped by a weaker currency, traders said. Shares in Siebe were up 28p at 996p by 1356 GMT, IMI Plc added 18-1/2p to 384p and TI Group Plc gained 13-1/2p to 553p. "The IMI figures were quite good this morning, and that has helped set the trend for the sector," said one trader. "Currency is also a factor," the trader added.

Diversified engineering group IMI earlier reported profits of 137.5 million stg, beating analysts best expectations. TI Group is scheduled to report earnings on Wednesday. "There is a bit of a squeeze going on in the sector," a trader said. "All the engineers are a firm market today." The sector was also benefiting from relative weakness in the value of sterling, traders said. The currency slipped against both the dollar and the mark on Monday after mild UK inflation data and amid further signs of strife in the ruling Conservative party. "These are currency-sensitive stocks which have been hit by sterling related downgrades, so the currency is providing some relief and helping to lift the sector," one dealer said.
